Type: rug
Name: Rivet Flatwoven Cubist-Inspired Rug, 4' x 6', Cream and Gray with Orange
This contemporary rug will add texture, depth, and color wherever you have a bare floor or need to create visual interest in a room. Though the pattern is bold, the blues, grays, and oranges of the soft wool-and-cotton pile are classic colors that will blend with almost any color scheme. 4'W x 6'L 71% wool, 24% cotton, 5% Lurex Transitional design in colors that can be paired with any decor Pair with rug pad (sold separately)
